{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low in early periods and too high in later periods, showing lag and overshoot dynamics",
    "Sentiment signals have delayed impact - positive sentiment doesn't immediately translate to higher forecasts",
    "Mean reversion bias exists as forecasts converge toward historical means while true outcomes maintain more volatility",
    "When sentiment turns positive ( > 0.5 ), model underforecasts by approximately 1-2 points",
    "As history extends into the future, model forecasts diverge from true outcomes with systematic overshooting at medium horizons",
    "Sentiment negativity ( < 0.33 ) correlates with model being too conservative by ~0.5-1 point",
    "The forecast gap between model and true outcome expands in the middle 10-15 day range of the 30-day horizon"
] }
